title: Fungal Genomic DNA Extraction
author: Jana M U'Ren
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.qtjdwkn

Very gently invert tube 20 times to mix.

steps.title: Grind Mycelium
steps.instruction: Grind mycelium into a fine powder using a sterile mortar and pestle and liquid nitrogen.

substeps.instruction: Pre-chill the mortar and pestle by pouring liquid nitrogen from a small red insulated box into them.
Add mycelium from a -80°C tube and half the volume of the mortar of liquid nitrogen.
Chip away at the mycelium before grinding to prevent pieces from flying.
Add liquid nitrogen in intervals as needed to ensure the sample does not thaw.
Grind to a fine powder, ensuring not to over-grind to avoid DNA destruction.
If processing multiple samples, grind one at a time and store completed samples at -80°C.

steps.title: Transfer Ground Mycelium
steps.instruction: Quickly transfer the ground mycelium into a 50mL Falcon tube.

substeps.instruction: Use the original 50mL tube only if all non-ground mycelium was removed during grinding.
Otherwise, use a new 50mL tube that has been quickly submerged in liquid nitrogen to chill.

steps.title: Prepare Samples on Ice
steps.instruction: Remove all ground samples from the freezer and place them on ice.

steps.title: Add SDS Buffer
steps.instruction: Add SDS Buffer to each sample based on the amount of ground mycelium.

substeps.instruction: Use a ratio of approximately 14mL SDS Buffer per 3-4g of ground mycelium to ensure even homogenization.

steps.title: Incubate Samples
steps.instruction: Incubate the samples at 65°C for 30 minutes.

substeps.instruction: Gently invert the samples 5 times every 10 minutes.

steps.title: Precipitate Proteins
steps.instruction: Add potassium acetate to the samples and incubate.

substeps.instruction: Add 0.5X volume of potassium acetate (5M KOAc, pH 7.5) and invert to mix.
Place on ice for 30 minutes.
Centrifuge at 4500 RPM for 10 minutes at 4°C.
Remove the supernatant and place it in a new tube.
Repeat this process 3 times.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA
steps.instruction: Precipitate the DNA using cold isopropanol.

substeps.instruction: Add 0.7X volume of ice-cold isopropanol and invert to mix.
Centrifuge at 4500 RPM for 20 minutes at 4°C to pellet the DNA.
Pour the supernatant into a glass beaker.

steps.title: Wash DNA Pellet
steps.instruction: Wash the DNA pellet with ethanol.

substeps.instruction: Wash the pellet with 5 mL 70% EtOH.
Centrifuge for 5 minutes at 4500 RPM and pour off the supernatant.
Quickly spin the tubes to gather residual ethanol at the bottom.
Carefully remove residual EtOH with a P1000 tip.

steps.title: Dry and Resuspend Pellet
steps.instruction: Dry the pellet and resuspend it in TE buffer.

substeps.instruction: Allow the pellet to air dry for 5 minutes in the biosafety cabinet (do not overdry).
Resuspend the pellet in 2mL TE.
Add 10uL RNase (20mg/mL).
Heat in a 37°C water bath for 60 minutes.

steps.title: Phenol-Chloroform Extraction
steps.instruction: Perform organic extraction in a chemical fume hood.

substeps.instruction: Add 2mL of Phenol:Chloroform:IAA (1:1) to the sample.
Very gently invert the samples 20X until the mixture turns a 'milky' white color.
Centrifuge at 4500 RPM for 25 minutes at 4°C.

steps.title: Collect Aqueous Layer
steps.instruction: Recover the aqueous layer in a chemical fume hood.

substeps.instruction: Carefully remove as much of the aqueous layer as possible and place it in a new 5mL microcentrifuge tube, ensuring the interface is not disturbed.

steps.title: Remove Polysaccharides
steps.instruction: Precipitate excess polysaccharides using absolute molecular grade ethanol.

substeps.instruction: Add 0.3X volume of absolute molecular grade ethanol to each tube.
Centrifuge at maximum speed (4500 RPM) for 35 minutes.
Carefully remove the supernatant without disturbing the polysaccharide pellet and transfer it to a new 5mL centrifuge tube (split into two tubes if necessary).
Add 1.7X volume of absolute molecular grade ethanol to each tube.
Centrifuge at maximum speed (4500 RPM) for 35 minutes.
Carefully pour off the supernatant without disturbing the pellet.

steps.title: Final Pellet Wash
steps.instruction: Wash the gDNA pellet to remove excess salt.

substeps.instruction: Add 4 mL of 70% ethanol.
Centrifuge at maximum speed (4500 RPM) for 5 minutes and pour off the supernatant.
Repeat the wash once more.
Quickly centrifuge the tube to gather residual ethanol at the bottom and remove it with a P20 tip.

steps.title: Final Drying and Resuspension
steps.instruction: Dry the pellet and resuspend in low salt TE.

substeps.instruction: Air dry the pellet for 5 minutes in the biosafety cabinet (do not overdry).
Resuspend the pellet in 25 uL low salt TE (increase volume in 10uL intervals if needed).
Gently agitate by flicking the tube.
Place in a 65°C water bath in increments of 5-10 minutes, adding more low salt TE if needed, for a total time not exceeding one hour.

steps.title: Sample Transfer and Quantification
steps.instruction: Transfer and quantify the extracted DNA.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the sample to a 1.5mL microcentrifuge tube using a wide bore P1000 pipette.
Prepare a 1:20 dilution of the samples.
Measure DNA purity and concentration using Nanodrop and Qubit.
